children: Silver Bow Mining advanced its Montana Tunnels acquisition with an Initial Closing, releasing about $28.58 million from escrow to satisfy specified creditor claims. In exchange, the company received a senior secured seller note of approximately $28.58 million, backed by security, guaranty, pledge, and a mortgage over MTMI assets, plus a Support Agreement from certain Montana Goldfields shareholders. Separately, Silver Bow funded Montana Goldfields with $5 million across two senior secured notes bearing 8% interest and six-month maturities, which may be repaid by surrendering specified CVRs to be issued at final closing or in cash if not issued. An amended and restated pledge secures these bridge notes with interests in the CVRs and shares of Elkhorn Goldfields.
